purpose: LRM 5.10.3.3: a timer event is an accepted time point, even off the printstep grid

oracle.derivation: The attached model raises lvl on two single-shot timers, at 2.5e-4 s and 6.25e-4 s, and drives V(p,n) = 1.0*lvl. Both start times fall strictly between the deck's printsteps (0, 1e-4, 2e-4, ...), so a row at either coordinate exists only if the simulator placed a time point on the event, as 5.10.3.3 requires ('The analog simulator places a time point within time_tol of an event. At that time point, the event evaluates to True.'). Levels are exact integers: 0 V at t=0 because both start times are still in the future, 1 V at 2.5e-4 after the first timer fires, 2 V at 6.25e-4 after the second. The check demands the exact coordinate, so a grid that merely straddles the event fails with MissingCoordinate rather than being rescued by interpolation.
